description_en: Queries the list of backup sets by calling the DescribeBackupSetList operation
description_zh: 调用DescribeBackupSetList接口查看备份集列表
kebab_example: aliyun polardbx describe-backup-set-list --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-name pxc-xxxxxx --start-time 1635707845000 --end-time 1635707845000 --page-size 30 --page-number 1 --dest-cross-region cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeBackupSetList

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the instance resides
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The start time timestamp, in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间的时间戳， 单位为毫秒
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time timestamp, in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间的时间戳， 单位为毫秒
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The region where the backup set resides. After you specify this parameter, backup sets in the specified region are returned. Only one region can be specified at a time
parameters.help_zh: 备份集所在的地域，指定后可返回某个具体地域的备份集，一次仅支持指定一个地域
parameters.name: dest_cross_region
